from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class HousingStartRecord(BaseModel):
    """A single monthly data point extracted from a housing starts report."""
    month: str | None = Field(description="The month covered by the data, formatted as YYYY-MM")
    saar: float | None = Field(description="Seasonally Adjusted Annual Rate (in thousands)")
    nsa: float | None = Field(description="Not Seasonally Adjusted count (in thousands)")
    report_date: str | None = Field(description="Release date of the report providing this data (YYYY-MM-DD)")
    release_id: str | None = Field(description="Report release number or identifier (e.g., CB22-156)")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    """The parsed output for a single document containing housing starts data."""
    housing_start_records: list[HousingStartRecord]
